title: The Astrophage Crisis
author: NotSoMagnifique
rules:
A microorganism called astrophage, currently of unknown origin, is consuming the energy of the sun to feed its growth cycle, and looping back and forth to Venus along a course named for astronomer Dr. Irina Petrova.

Scientists on Earth have assembled a multi-national team to address the problem, including sending a manned mission out into space to discover where astrophage comes from and possibly how to stop it - it turns out astrophage makes for excellent rocket fuel. We wish godspeed to our travelers!

----

Rules:

- Normal sudoku rules apply.

- Global entropy - every 2 by 2 box of cells on the star map must contain at least one low digit (1, 2, or 3), one medium digit (4, 5, 6), and one high digit (7, 8, or 9).

- Sun Maximization - the sum of the four digits on the Sun (located in Box 3) must be the maximum allowed by global entropy.

- Petrova Line - neighboring digits along the red Petrova line connecting the Sun to the planet Venus (R7C5) must alternate between being odd and even.

- Planetary Oddness - The planets Earth (R5C2) and Venus (R7C5) are marked on the star map by gray circles. The planetary digits must be odd, and the value on Earth must be greater than the value on Venus.

- Astrophage - digits separated by a black Astrophage dot must be in a 2:1 ratio. No negative constraint.

- Rocket Path - neighboring digits on the green rocket path leaving Earth must differ in value by at least 5.
